claim: In July 2022, Iran ran a targeted measles vaccination campaign for children and vulnerable communities; refugee families without immigration documents were vaccinated, and the article says confirmed cases fell dramatically.
source_confidence_reason: UNICEF provides a dated field story with concrete operational details, named beneficiaries, and an explicit 2022 campaign result, though it is still a program story rather than an audit.
